warnings.title: State Management Complexity
warnings.description: App.tsx contains 25+ boolean state flags for screen management
warnings.recommendation: Consider implementing React Router or state machine pattern (XState/Zustand)

warnings.title: Code Splitting Opportunity
warnings.description: All components are imported directly in App.tsx without lazy loading
warnings.recommendation: Implement React.lazy() for route-based code splitting

warnings.title: TypeScript Strictness
warnings.description: Some component props use 'any' type instead of explicit interfaces
warnings.impact: Reduced type safety and IDE autocomplete
warnings.recommendation: Define strict TypeScript interfaces for all props

recommendations.title: Implement Code Splitting
recommendations.description: Use React.lazy() to split category components into separate bundles
recommendations.benefit: Faster initial load time, better user experience
recommendations.implementation: Wrap category imports with React.lazy() and Suspense

recommendations.title: Add Service Worker
recommendations.description: Implement service worker for offline functionality and caching
recommendations.implementation: Use Workbox or custom service worker

recommendations.title: State Machine for Navigation
recommendations.description: Replace boolean flags with XState or Zustand state machine
recommendations.benefit: Cleaner code, easier debugging, better state visualization
recommendations.implementation: Create navigation state machine with defined states and transitions

recommendations.title: Enable Strict TypeScript Mode
recommendations.description: Enable 'strict: true' in tsconfig.json and fix type issues
recommendations.benefit: Better type safety, fewer runtime errors
recommendations.implementation: Update tsconfig.json and add explicit types

recommendations.title: Add Component Documentation
recommendations.description: Add JSDoc comments to complex components
recommendations.implementation: Add JSDoc with param descriptions and examples

recommendations.title: Export Design Tokens
recommendations.description: Export colors, spacing, typography as JSON
recommendations.implementation: Create tokens.json with all design values

recommendations.title: Create Component Library
recommendations.description: Package reusable UI components as internal npm package
recommendations.implementation: Extract UI components, setup npm package

recommendations.title: Add Test Coverage
recommendations.description: Implement Jest + React Testing Library for unit and integration tests
recommendations.benefit: Confidence in refactoring, catch bugs early
recommendations.implementation: Setup Jest, write tests for critical flows, target 80% coverage
